description: AI-generated landscape brand/design-system board (not CAD): gold multi-line AGF wordmark on forest green, 'Sound Connects Everything.' tagline, forest-green/brass/warm-neutral palette with hex codes, Monoton/Poiret One/Commissioner typography panel, hero panel with brass AGF headphones on a mossy hillside ('Higher Fidelity A Broader World.'), UI components, iconography, spacing and brand applications (box, mic, hoodie, mug, laptop hero, electronics).

AI-generated portrait 'master design system & brand architecture v1.0' board (not CAD; text is partly garbled by the generator): deep green PCB-textured background with gold traces, headline 'The Forest Holds the Gold.', three-tier brand architecture (AGF // HEAR, HIELD, AIR), colour swatches, material spec sheet, PCB trace motifs, floating-ground badge and a web mock showing a black brass-knobbed amp with a -132.4 dBu THD+N telemetry card.

AI-generated landscape brand board (not CAD): outlined gold AGF wordmark with equaliser bars on dark green, Commissioner type scale with a '96"' data callout, pill-shaped colour swatches with hex codes, and an equipment and merch strip (black/brass mic and audio interface, green box with AGF, black and gold headphones, phone UI, 'EST. 2026' badge).

AI-generated photoreal packaging shot (not CAD): open dark-green rigid box with embossed circuit-trace lid and gold 'AGF ALL GROUNDS FLOATING' mark, a black-and-gold-edged certificate card headed 'Measured in Silence.' with a ground symbol, serial/noise-floor/THD+N table and engineer signature, a green braided cable with brass plugs and a brushed brass cylinder in the foam tray.

AI-generated product board (not CAD) headed 'Wasted Real-Estate': black round earbud case with brass crown and triangle logo, Dolby and l'Art on the screen, UI screens, port close-ups, exploded internals, DJ photo, feature icons, '$299 accessory / $799 investment' pricing line and stereOS logo. Black with brass/gold type.

AI-generated square ad/board (not CAD): black rounded-rectangle earbud case with two brass-mesh earbuds, a red LED display reading 'stereOS LIVE to GLOBAL VILLAGE' with green/red L-CH/R-CH readouts, outlined gold AGF wordmark top left, headline 'Live, Anywhere. Heard, Everywhere.' and four icon columns.

AI-generated three-panel venue concept board: 'The Bar / The Stage' (front of house, red-curtain stage, bar), 'The Balcony' (pro mixing consoles and monitors over a purple-lit stage) and 'The Green Room' (hidden retail room with an 'AGF | l'Art Production' sign); each panel has a label, headline, body copy and a VIBE line. Dark, amber/purple lighting, cream and gold type.

Photo (stock-style, with text overlay) of a dark performance venue: marble-fronted bar, band on a wood-slat stage, red seating and a balcony of racked production gear labelled 'l'Art Production'; overlaid headings 'The Bar & The Stage', 'The Balcony', 'The Green Room' with body copy and a 'Green Room' door sign. Warm amber, cream type.

AI-generated render (not CAD) of a wood-and-marble 'maestro' control surface on the balcony rail above a dark jazz venue stage: copper-knob equalizer and source panels, two stage-camera monitors, 'VIRTUAL TICKETS 888' and 'LIVE TO AIR IN 8:00 MINUTES' tiles, faders and a wireless keyboard. Black marble, copper and walnut.

CAD render (grey studio background, 1920x1083) of the massFidelity 'USB Audio' DAC: dark green slab with brass base plate and a large brass knob at the front-right corner; 'massFIDELITY' on the front edge, 'USB Audio' on the top.

CAD render of the same USB Audio DAC slab from the rear/right: dark grey body, copper knob top-left, rear connector strip (red switch, USB-C, four copper binding posts, HDMI, optical, RCA pairs). No massFidelity logo is visible, only mirrored 'USB Audio' text on top.
CAD render of the massFidelity 'USB Audio' DAC in black with a gold-brass knob and 'massFIDELITY' on the front edge; grey studio background.

CAD render of a different massFidelity DAC: low black box with a copper-edged front panel (four round buttons and a USB-C port), a translucent top inset with a copper raised slider/handle, 'massFIDELITY' printed on the top; grey background.

Technical exploded-assembly drawing (white sheet with border) of the USB Audio box with brass knob: callouts for assembly knob, top panel, spacers, PCB LED, back/side/front/bottom panels, mounting brackets and connector PCB. Small multicolour 'EP' logo stamp bottom-left. No massFidelity text.
CAD render of the black 'REMORA' behind-the-TV speaker, a curved slab mounted on the back of a flat-screen TV on a black desk; 'REMORA' in white capitals on the grille.
Grey-background CAD diagram of the white 'REMORA' speaker lifted off the back of a TV, with dashed mounting-screw lines to a VESA plate.

White-background CAD render of the REMORA enclosure with a transparent grille showing the internal driver layout: eight round woofers/radiators and racetrack drivers on the edges; 'REMORA' in white type.
Spec slide: CAD wireframe of the REMORA driver layout on grey at right and a text list of driver counts at left (12 racetrack drivers, 4 subwoofers, 4 passive radiators).

CAD render on black: round black earbud case with two earbuds floating above their pockets and a small colour screen showing 'LATE IN THE EVENING / Paul Simon' with prev/next arrows; four hairline buttons on the front.
CAD render on black: round black earbud case with a Dolby double-D logo embossed on the lid and a front screen showing 'KOD J. Cole' with an 'E' badge and prev/next arrows.
AI-generated image of an in-wall plate: dark walnut veneer with sunburst grain, a large brass knob on a green enamel ring, and a round OLED reading 'ANALOG 144' with a blue underline.
AI-generated close-up of a round in-wall control: brass outer ring, green lacquer well, a graphite knob and a small 'ANALOG' label on a pale wall.
AI-generated image of a wall plate: dark green panel in a walnut frame, a brass knob on a brass collar and the label 'ANALOG', in a softly lit room.

AI-generated living-room concept: floating white-marble console with two round black speaker drivers and planters, a small control module, under a black-cased roll-down projector screen on a cream wall, wood floor.
Unbranded grey CAD model of a full-size keyboard with a raised rear strip of four-knob groups (blue indicators), jog-wheel style controls and two keys at the left, on dark grey background.

Product render of over-ear headphones with tan leather band and pads and silver-grey shells on a dark navy dusk backdrop; USB-C port and LED visible. No brand marking. Byte-identical to section-backgrounds/prelude-square-1.png.

Marketing-style render: two white over-ear headphones on a white charging stand in a living room with TV and blue sofa, captioned 'MV2 Bundle+'. Byte-identical to section-backgrounds/prelude-hero.png.
Product render of two over-ear headphones overlapping, one black and one red with black pads, on a light grey background. No brand marking.
AI-generated 1024x1024 image of a sculpture on a dark grey gradient: flowing copper/brass wire ribbons wrapped around a teal verdigris audio waveform.
AI-generated render: black 'USB Audio' box with 'AGF' on the front edge and a large copper knob, sitting on a walnut shelf slab against a pale wall.

AI-generated home-theatre room: wall-hung TV (branded 'SOTA') flanked by two tall slim dark-green speakers with brass driver rings, a small green-and-brass 'USB Audio' box on a black floating console with under-lighting. Byte-identical to section-backgrounds/prelude-hero.webp.
CAD render of the slim tower speaker in walnut veneer with a honeycomb grille top and one round driver, on a mauve-grey background.
CAD render of the same tower with a brushed copper front panel.
CAD render of the same tower in dark green with brass edge trim and a brass driver ring.

Close-up CAD render of the copper tower's driver on a black bezel.
